summary: The diff implements the three requirements: ShortSportPage now reads the optional postId URL parameter and moves the matching post to the front of the feed (REQ-3); MessagesPage renders a tappable ShortSport preview card for messages with a postId and navigates to /shortsport?postId=<id> (REQ-2); the route tree adds validateSearch for the postId parameter. All core requirements appear addressed. Minor uncertainty exists due to file truncation, but evidence is strong across all three requirements.
